name: Grease
summary: Covers a 10-foot square in slippery grease that knocks creatures Prone.

m.text: a bit of pork rind or butter

stats.effect:
Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into {ref:glossary/difficult-terrain} for the duration.

When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall {ref:condition/prone}.
